selection: all ten c/loop-* directories at the pin, every .c that its .yml names as input; no case removed and no case added; property = unreach-call if declared, else no-overflow (SV-COMP order), one unit per (case, property)
labels: expected_verdict from the same .yml, used for scoring only; both verdicts present in the set, so the unsafe side is measured too

held_out.rule: a case is development data if its (directory, file) appears in any earlier experiment's translated.json; otherwise it was never parsed before this study
held_out.note: nothing here is claimed as held out beyond what this rule supports

llmloop_configuration: unchanged front end scripts/svcomp_translate.py with GHOST on and NOOVF per case property; deterministic default then existing polynomial profile only if default not proved; 60 samples, 150 rounds, 5 s per query, seed 1; UNSUPPORTED retained
cbmc_configuration: --no-standard-checks --unwind 64 --unwinding-assertions, plus --signed-overflow-check on no-overflow cases; incomplete unrolling is UNKNOWN
ultimate_configuration: unmodified v0.3.2 release, default/bitvector portfolio, JVM Xmx1G, internal timeout 600 s inside the same 600 s host cap
timing: concurrent throughput observations, not cross-tool speedup; wait4 CPU, sampled group RSS, stdout/stderr and the actual command lines retained
